topic: 环境话题与学术阅读定位
grammarFocus: 被动语态；因果表达；分词作定语的基础辨认。
title: Campus Recycling and Study Skills
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 10 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。判断题 True 表示原文明示支持，False 表示原文明示矛盾，Not Given 表示缺少判断所需信息。
transcript:
Tom: Hi, Lisa. How is the university's new recycling program going?
Lisa: It's going well, but we have some issues. The program was designed by students and staff together. Special bins were placed in every building, but the bins are often contaminated.
Tom: Contaminated? What do you mean?
Lisa: People put the wrong things in them. Yesterday someone put a greasy pizza box in the paper bin. The food left on it caused a problem. That whole load had to be checked before it could be processed.
Tom: What are you doing about it?
Lisa: We're making new signs. They will have pictures to show what goes where.
Tom: When will they be ready?
Lisa: They should be ready by next Monday. Also, we're organizing training for volunteers. We'll teach volunteers how to sort waste properly because mixed-up waste creates extra work.
Tom: How many volunteers do you have?
Lisa: About 50 students are volunteering now. We need more, especially during exam weeks. Volunteers can choose a short shift rather than missing a whole afternoon of study.
Tom: I could help. I have some free time.
Lisa: Great! We meet every Tuesday at 4 pm in the student center. I'll introduce you to the team, and then you can choose a shift.
Tom: Is the program making a difference?
Lisa: Yes. In our simulated project records, the amount of waste sent to landfill has dropped by 30% since we started.
Tom: And do students support it?
Lisa: A survey showed that 80% of students support the program. That was our campus survey last week; it doesn't tell us what students at other universities think.
Tom: What happens next?
Lisa: The university is planning to expand it to the local community next year. We hope it will inspire other groups. But the waste problem is not completely solved. We still find the wrong items in some bins.
Tom: Then I'll see you on Tuesday and help with the next stage.

grammar.title: 被动语态与分词作定语
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语承受动作，基本结构为 be + 过去分词；时态变化体现在 be 上，如 were placed、will be built。作名词修饰语时，过去分词常表示被动或完成，如 a broken window；现在分词常表示主动或正在进行，如 a sleeping baby。不要只看词尾，要看名词与动作的关系。表达原因可用 because + 从句，表达结果可用 so + 从句。
grammar.example: The program was designed by students and staff together.

questions.prompt: Choose the passive form: The new library ______ next year.
questions.explanation: 图书馆承受建造动作，且是明年，用将来时被动语态 will be built。
questions.evidence: The new library will be built next year.

questions.prompt: Choose the past participle meaning“已经被打碎的”：The ______ window was replaced.
questions.explanation: broken 是 break 的过去分词，表示窗户已被打碎。

questions.prompt: Choose the passive form: Many trees ______ in the park last year.
questions.explanation: 树承受种植动作，last year 要求过去时，复数 trees 配 were planted。
questions.evidence: Many trees were planted in the park last year.

questions.prompt: Choose the past participle meaning“已经被污染的”：The ______ water is not safe to drink.
questions.explanation: polluted 表示水承受污染动作；题目明确要求过去分词。
questions.evidence: The polluted water is not safe to drink.
